environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet behind an internal ALB. The ALB has a listener rule on port 443 with a fixed-response 403 as the default action. Forward rules are conditioned on source-ip matching a prefix list maintained via AWS RAM shared resource (pl-0a1b2c3d4e5f) which resolves to 10.128.0.0/16 and 172.20.0.0/14 — the VPC CIDR ranges of the three upstream microservice clusters. The ALB security group ingress is restricted to the same CIDRs. Additionally, the Fargate task's ENI security group only permits inbound TCP/8080 from the ALB security group (sg-0abc123def456). There is no NAT gateway or internet gateway route in the private subnet route table, and no VPC peering or transit gateway attachment exists to any non-production account. The prefix list is updated via a Lambda triggered by Config rules and cannot be modified by the application team (governed by SCP denying ec2:ModifyManagedPrefixList for all OUs except NetworkAdmin).
